blurb: Where your child takes dance class matters! When looking for a studio, find one that has knowledgeable, experienced teachers. Consider ones that care more about your child’s personal and technical development than awards and studio recognition. From the first “rite of passage” ballet class to the advanced, technique-driven dancer, find a place that will inspire passion and self-confidence in each and every student.
